newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Palestinians crack down on PLO radicals - PFLP.
newsitem.headline: Palestinians crack down on PLO radicals - PFLP.

text.p: Yasser Arafat's Palestinian Authority has begun a crackdown on a radical PLO group whose guerrillas ambushed Jewish settlers in the West Bank this week, a leader of the group said on Friday.

Israel has demanded the Authority crack down on the Popular Front for the Liberation of Palestine (PFLP), which took responsibility for the killing of two Jewish settlers in a drive-by shooting in the West Bank on Wednesday.
Abdel-Rahim Mallouh, a PFLP politburo member, said Palestinian security forces detained scores of PFLP activists all over the West Bank.
They also barred the group on Friday from holding a rally in the town of Ramallah to mark its 29th anniversay, he said.

"We were surprised this morning when they informed us that there is a decision not to hold the rally these days," Mallouh told Reuters. He said the rally had been licenced by the Palestinian Authority.

A Palestinian security official, who declined to be identified, said there was no written order issued by the Palestinian Authority to ban the rally and that the PFLP must have decided to postpone it.
The Damascus-based PFLP opposes Israeli-PLO peace moves that have launched limited Palestinian autonomy in parts of the West bank and Gaza Strip.
Mallouh said Palestinian security forces have rounded up activists from the PLO-ruled West Bank towns of Jenin, Bethlehem, Tulkarm and Ramallah. He said about 20 were detained in Ramallah alone.

In Damascus, George Habash, 71-year-old head of the PFLP. pledged more attacks on Israelis and urged Palestinians to embark on a fresh uprising against the Jewish state and its occupation of Arab land.
Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's government, in a defiant response to the PFLP attack, decided on Friday to grant financial benefits to Jewish settlers in the occupied West Bank.
The Palestinian Information Ministry called the decision "a direct call for violence and declaration of war on the Palestinian people and its National Authority."
